outcome: pressure pain threshold (PPT) of L4-5 supraspinous ligament
relaxation time of L4-5 supraspinous ligament
cohort: The study included 44 women, comprising 22 who experienced spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery and 22 controls who never had pregnancy or anesthesia.
finding: Women who experienced spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery showed increased tenderness and lower pressure pain threshold at the L4-5 site 6-12 weeks postpartum, with minor changes in supraspinous ligament biomechanics.
